content: {"reasoning": "Prior auth is required and missing, but this payer offers no retroactive auth window and no peer-to-peer, so requesting either would violate published rules and count as a process mistake; an appeal is impossible without a denial on the table. Timely filing has 163 days left, so the claim must be put in front of the payer now to either obtain payment or generate the denial needed for an appeal. Attaching the supporting medical records with the initial submission gives the best chance the payer adjudicates on medical necessity despite the missing auth, and it avoids a wasted extra touch later.", "action": "submit_with_records"}
